title: Apple Stock Price Prediction Dataset
description: A comprehensive dataset combining Apple Inc. (AAPL) 5-year historical stock data with news sentiment analysis. Includes technical indicators (SMA, EMA, RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands, ATR, ADX) and GPT-generated sentiment scores from multi-source news articles (NewsAPI, Yahoo Finance, Google RSS). Intended for machine learning stock price prediction tasks.
